item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence using anything like current AI techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We must stop treating this as an ordinary technological race and impose an enforceable global halt.

2. We reject the idea that companies or governments should gamble with every human life. Superintelligence built with anything like today’s techniques will kill everyone. No promised benefit can justify taking that risk.

3. We need international law with real enforcement to prevent the creation of superintelligence using current techniques. If anyone succeeds in building it, everyone dies. The only responsible course is to stop it before it is built.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 116 words

We need to say this plainly: if anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. Current AI systems are not understood well enough to make such a creation controllable, and scaling them toward capabilities beyond every human mind would not fix that failure. It would place the future of our species in the hands of a system more capable than humanity and not reliably bound to human survival. No company, government, or laboratory has the right to impose that outcome on the world. We are calling for an enforceable global halt to any effort aimed at creating superintelligence with current techniques. Nothing less matches the scale and certainty of the danger.
